techniques.name: Temperature tuning
techniques.goal: Control randomness/concentration in compatible sampling models
techniques.mechanism: Scale logits before sampling; lower values concentrate probability, higher values diversify.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Store per-model/task optimum; do not tune temperature and top-p together by default.
risks: Low temperature can entrench top error

techniques.name: Top-p tuning
techniques.goal: Adapt candidate-token set to probability mass
techniques.mechanism: Sample only from smallest token set covering chosen cumulative probability mass.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Treat as alternative to temperature, not simultaneous arbitrary knob.
risks: Too low causes brittle output; too high admits tail errors

techniques.name: Deterministic/low-randomness decoding for machine steps
techniques.goal: Reduce run-to-run variance for extraction, routing and tool planning
techniques.mechanism: Use lowest supported stochasticity or constrained/greedy-like generation for machine-facing stages.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Pair with verifier/escalation so consistency is not mistaken for correctness.
avoid_when: Creative ideation where diversity is desired

techniques.name: Log-probability diagnostics
techniques.goal: Expose token-level distribution information for diagnostics/routing on models that support it
techniques.mechanism: Capture chosen-token and alternate-token log probabilities; derive margins/entropy features and calibrate them empirically.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use only as one feature in calibrated uncertainty model.
avoid_when: Treating raw logprob as semantic confidence
risks: Token probability is not factual confidence

techniques.name: Hard output-token budget
techniques.goal: Bound cost/latency and runaway output
techniques.mechanism: Set max generated-token budget including invisible reasoning/formatting where provider defines it that way.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Learn budget distribution per task/model and reserve safety headroom.
avoid_when: Budget too tight to leave required reasoning/output headroom
risks: Can spend reasoning tokens and return no visible result if too low

techniques.name: Hard tool-call budget
techniques.goal: Bound exploration and accidental tool loops
techniques.mechanism: Set provider or orchestrator maximum tool calls and escalate/stop when exhausted.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use task-class budgets and loop-guard event on exhaustion.
avoid_when: Known workflow legitimately requires more calls than bound

techniques.name: Output verbosity control
techniques.goal: Reduce generation latency/tokens without altering the underlying task objective
techniques.mechanism: Select low/medium/high response verbosity where provider/model supports it or prompt an equivalent concise machine output.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Default low for internal stages; render human detail separately.
risks: Too terse can omit needed caveats/evidence

techniques.name: Fail-on-overflow instead of automatic truncation
techniques.goal: Prevent silent loss of early conversation/context
techniques.mechanism: Disable automatic truncation so oversized requests fail visibly and trigger explicit compaction/retrieval.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS should own compaction instead of provider silently dropping context.
avoid_when: Disposable casual chat where best-effort truncation is acceptable

techniques.name: Grammar-constrained decoding
techniques.goal: Guarantee syntactic adherence to a grammar
techniques.mechanism: Compile JSON Schema/regex/CFG/EBNF into valid-token masks during decoding so illegal continuations cannot be sampled.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: For local models benchmark engine/version using real Agent OS schemas.
avoid_when: Provider already supplies reliable structured output

techniques.name: Schema-constrained JSON generation
techniques.goal: Guarantee required fields/types/enums at generation time
techniques.mechanism: Specialize constrained decoding to JSON Schema rather than post-hoc parsing/retries.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Always follow with semantic/business-rule validation.

techniques.name: Regex/literal-choice constrained generation
techniques.goal: Make small classifications exact and cheap
techniques.mechanism: Constrain output to a small set of literals or regex language.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Include explicit unknown/abstain where uncertainty is real.
avoid_when: Rich explanation needed in same field
risks: Constraint hides uncertainty unless abstain option exists

techniques.name: Interleaved deterministic control + generation
techniques.goal: Move loops/branches/schema enforcement from prose into program control
techniques.mechanism: Use a prompt-program framework or ordinary code to alternate fixed control, constrained fields and free generation in one logical operation.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prefer plain Agent OS workflow code unless framework clearly reduces calls/complexity.
avoid_when: Simple API call where framework adds more abstraction than value

techniques.name: MIPRO-style joint instruction+demonstration optimization
techniques.goal: Optimize multiple prompt variables across a multi-stage LM program
techniques.mechanism: Generate candidate instructions/examples and search combinations using program-level metric/Bayesian optimization.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Run optimizer only after eval registry and immutable holdout exist.
use_when: Stable workflow with representative training/dev evals

techniques.name: GEPA reflective evolutionary prompt optimization
techniques.goal: Use rich trajectory feedback to evolve prompts more sample-efficiently than scalar-only optimization
techniques.mechanism: Reflect on execution traces to propose natural-language rules/changes; retain Pareto-diverse candidates and recombine lessons.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Optimizer cannot alter immutable policy; structural constraints/regressions are hard gates.
use_when: Agent workflows with interpretable traces and strong eval
techniques.cost_profile: offline model calls, potentially fewer than RL

techniques.name: Heuristic/evolutionary prompt search
techniques.goal: Search prompt space beyond manual edits
techniques.mechanism: Use mutation, paraphrase, crossover, beam/evolution/bandit/Bayesian search over candidate instructions or exemplars.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Catalog optimizer provenance and every evaluated candidate hash.
avoid_when: Tiny task or metric too noisy

techniques.name: Prompt optimizer stability constraints
techniques.goal: Prevent optimizer from breaking schemas, safety requirements or downstream contracts while improving score
techniques.mechanism: Freeze immutable prompt regions/contracts; validate candidate structure before expensive eval; include stability/regression metrics in objective.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Authorization and security instructions are not optimizer-editable.

techniques.name: RAG-Fusion / reciprocal-rank fusion of query variants
techniques.goal: Increase retrieval breadth and robustness to one poor query
techniques.mechanism: Generate several semantically diverse queries, retrieve each, combine ranked lists using reciprocal rank fusion.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Cap query count and require original-query relevance in reranker.

techniques.name: Corrective RAG (retrieval quality gate)
techniques.goal: Detect poor retrieval before generation and trigger corrective retrieval
techniques.mechanism: Evaluate retrieved evidence quality; if low, refine query/search another corpus/web and filter/decompose evidence.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS policy chooses allowed corrective sources by domain.
use_when: Knowledge research with variable corpus coverage
avoid_when: High-authority closed corpus where web fallback is disallowed
risks: Evaluator can wrongly reject good evidence

techniques.name: Complexity-routed Adaptive RAG
techniques.goal: Avoid expensive iterative retrieval for easy questions while retaining it for hard questions
techniques.mechanism: Classify query complexity and choose no retrieval, one-shot retrieval, or iterative/multi-hop retrieval.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Combine task policy + evidence need, not complexity alone.
avoid_when: Freshness/policy mandates retrieval regardless of complexity
risks: Complexity estimate may not equal evidence need

techniques.name: Query2doc pseudo-document expansion
techniques.goal: Add terms/concepts likely to appear in relevant documents
techniques.mechanism: Generate a hypothetical/pseudo relevant document and concatenate/use it to expand sparse or dense retrieval query.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Tag expansion as synthetic and never cite it as evidence.
avoid_when: High-stakes retrieval where invented specifics may dominate

techniques.name: LLM permutation reranking (RankGPT-style)
techniques.goal: Use a strong generative model to rerank passages when relevance is nuanced
techniques.mechanism: Ask model to rank passage identifiers, often in windows/sliding permutations, then use ordering downstream.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use only as challenger; distill/rewrite deterministic reranker if pattern is stable.
avoid_when: High-volume retrieval where cross-encoder/smaller reranker suffices

techniques.name: Reranker distillation
techniques.goal: Keep strong LLM ranking quality at lower serving cost
techniques.mechanism: Generate ranking/permutation supervision from strong model and train smaller specialized reranker.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential Knowledge Engine optimization after enough private-safe ranking data accumulates.

techniques.name: Visual document retrieval (ColPali-style)
techniques.goal: Retrieve visually rich pages without losing layout/table/figure cues in OCR-only text
techniques.mechanism: Embed document page images with VLM multi-vector representations and late-interaction query matching.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential local-first document-intelligence challenger to OCR-text retrieval.
avoid_when: Private docs cannot be processed by chosen model boundary
risks: does not replace extraction/OCR for field values

techniques.name: Matryoshka/truncated embeddings
techniques.goal: Trade embedding storage/search speed for quality dynamically
techniques.mechanism: Use embeddings trained so prefixes of the vector retain coarse-to-fine information; truncate dimensions for cheap stages and use fuller vectors where needed.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Capability registry should benchmark 128/256/512/full dims if supported.
avoid_when: Arbitrary embedding model not trained for truncation

techniques.name: Two-stage embedding retrieval
techniques.goal: Use cheap coarse embedding stage then expensive precise rerank
techniques.mechanism: Retrieve broad candidates using lower-dimensional/quantized vectors, then rerank with full vectors/late interaction/cross encoder.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Set stage1 recall target conservatively and monitor misses.
risks: Coarse stage can irreversibly drop relevant item
